page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9ge.64xlarge is a high-density bare-metal GPU-accelerated server instance. It features 256 dedicated physical cores powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is configured with a single thread per core and runs on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 2304.0 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by eight integrated NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, delivering a combined 576 GB of high-speed video memory. For high-throughput distributed workloads, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 380 Gbps.

A key architectural tradeoff is the absence of local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Given the massive GPU memory, high system RAM, and substantial network throughput, this instance is designed for intensive workloads such as large language model training, complex deep learning, high-performance computing, and massive parallel data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9ge.64xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated server designed for intensive computational workloads. It features 256 dedicated physical cores powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, with one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 2304.0 GB of system memory and eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs providing a total of 576 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 380 Gbps. This hardware profile is optimized for large-scale artificial intelligence training, deep learning inference, and high-performance computing workloads.
